name: Stratus Global Holdings Berhad
summary: Stratus Global Holdings Berhad engages in the design, fabrication, installation, and commissioning of automated material handling systems (AMHS). The company offers conveyor-based AMHS, hybrid AMHS, transport systems, and ASRS (automated storage and retrieval system). It serves front-end and back-end semiconductor production companies. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Bayan Lepas, Malaysia.
